 Prakash Chandra Rana Petitioner(s)

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. S.K. Baral, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha & Another ....

Justice S.S. Mishra
 Crlmc No.4842 of 2023 & I.A. No.3278 of 2023
 Order

The petitioner has filed the present petition seeking quashing of the cognizance order dated 28.12.2012 passed in C.T. Case No.238 of 2012 by the learned S.D.J.M., Athagarh corresponding to Athagarh P.S. Case No.74(11) dated 11.04.2012 for the offences under Sections 294/506-II/420/406 IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the parties have now settled the dispute amicably out of court.
2. Issue notice to Opposite Party No.2 by Registered Post/Speed Post with A.D, requisites for which shall be filed within three working days.
Notice be made returnable within one week.
The parties are directed to file joint affidavit and appear before this court on the next date of hearing.
( S.S. Mishra ) Judge Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
